## Scope
- [ ] Changes match Android-native browser product scope
- [ ] Search provider remains Startpage unless documented GoreeCloud Search Stable gate passed
- [ ] No credentials, private data, tracking SDK, or unreviewed third-party code introduced
- [ ] URL cleaner, blocker, cookie and DNS claims match tested behavior
- [ ] GC UI design, accessibility and touch targets visually reviewed in light and dark modes
- [ ] JVM tests, Android build, Android Lint and representative device testing recorded
- [ ] README, docs and external canonical records updated as necessary
- [ ] No production release/deployment or APK delivery represented without evidence
